body: **Important** — added_lines() rescans the whole diff per file; O(files x hunks) on 200-file MRs

**Critical** — the improvised gather path writes to /tmp/omni_mr{id}_gather.json from multiple agents with no run-dir isolation; consolidate via one prepare step (omni_prepare) or races will corrupt the gather
**Minor** — posting guide still documents the unanchored glab position command
**Minor** — CI should run the contract tests on every PR, not only on main
